sql_calls.sql:
SELECT 'daily_sales' AS source, MIN(date)::text AS start_date, MAX(date)::text AS end_date, COUNT(*) AS rows, SUM(units_sold) AS units, SUM(revenue_inr) AS revenue
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecasts', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*), SUM(ordered_units), NULL
FROM store.forecasts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*), SUM(book_on_hand_close), NULL
FROM store.inventory_book
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_offs', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*), SUM(units), NULL
FROM store.write_offs
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG';

SELECT audit_ts, sku, status
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY audit_ts;

SELECT count_ts, sku, book_before, counted, adjustment, trigger
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY count_ts;

sql_calls.sql:
SELECT date, sku, units_sold, revenue_inr
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY date;

SELECT audit_ts, sku, status
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY audit_ts;

SELECT date, sku, forecast_units_per_day, sigma, reorder_point, order_up_to, book_on_hand, on_order, ordered_units, method
FROM store.forecasts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY date;

SELECT
  SUM(ds.units_sold) AS bags_sold_daily_sales,
  SUM(ds.revenue_inr) AS revenue_inr,
  (SELECT SUM(pl.qty)
   FROM store.pos_lines pl
   WHERE pl.sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
     AND pl.bill_ts >= DATE '2026-06-01'
     AND pl.bill_ts < DATE '2026-07-01') AS bags_sold_pos_lines,
  COUNT(*) AS daily_sales_rows,
  MIN(ds.date) AS first_date,
  MAX(ds.date) AS last_date
FROM store.daily_sales ds
WHERE ds.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND ds.date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND ds.date < DATE '2026-07-01';

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS audit_observations,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_observations,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty_observations,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') / COUNT(*), 2) AS observed_on_shelf_pct,
  MIN(audit_ts) AS first_audit,
  MAX(audit_ts) AS last_audit
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00';
